statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-18, Russia will launch at least 500 drones and missiles combined against Ukraine in a single overnight attack, as tallied by the Ukrainian Air Force.
resolution: A Ukrainian Air Force tally of Russian drones plus missiles launched in one overnight attack, dated between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-18, is at least 500, reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, Kyiv Independent.
failure_condition: Every Russian overnight aerial attack on Ukraine between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-18 involves fewer than 500 drones and missiles combined.

statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30, Ethiopian and Eritrean state forces will fight each other directly, including cross-border fire or air strikes on each other.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC report Ethiopian and Eritrean state forces fought each other directly between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30, beyond one government accusing the other of backing rebels.
failure_condition: Ethiopian and Eritrean state forces do not fight each other directly between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30.

statement: At its meeting of 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28, the FOMC will raise the federal funds target range above 3.75 to 4.00 percent, with the decision announced on 2026-10-28. Reference: 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: The Federal Reserve FOMC statement released 2026-10-28 sets a federal funds target range above 3.75 to 4.00 percent. Reference: 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The FOMC statement of 2026-10-28 leaves the target range at 3.75 to 4.00 percent or lowers it.

statement: The BLS Employment Situation for October 2026, scheduled for release on 2026-11-06, will report a negative first-published change in total nonfarm payroll employment.
resolution: The BLS Employment Situation release of 2026-11-06 reports October 2026 total nonfarm payroll employment change below zero as its first-published headline figure, seasonally adjusted.
failure_condition: The first-published October 2026 total nonfarm payroll employment change is zero or positive.

statement: ICE Brent December 2026 futures will settle below 90.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 100.27 in the packet market snapshot.
resolution: ICE published settlement for Brent December 2026 futures is below 90.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30 inclusive. Reference: 100.27 on the packet date.
failure_condition: ICE Brent December 2026 futures settle at or above 90.00 USD per barrel on every trading day between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog will add at least one Fortinet vulnerability, other than CVE-2026-104286, with a date-added value between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed lists a Fortinet entry, with a cveID other than CVE-2026-104286, whose dateAdded value falls between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Fortinet vulnerability other than CVE-2026-104286 receives a CISA KEV date-added value between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30.

statement: CISA will add at least one of the two maximum-severity Dell Container Storage Modules flaws, CVE-2026-63688 or CVE-2026-63692, to its KEV catalog with a date-added value between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed lists CVE-2026-63688 or CVE-2026-63692 with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-13 inclusive.
failure_condition: Neither CVE-2026-63688 nor CVE-2026-63692 receives a CISA KEV date-added value between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-13.

statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-06, the United States will formally prohibit or license-restrict exports of diesel or distillate fuel oil, through an executive order, proclamation, or Commerce rule published in the Federal Register.
resolution: The Federal Register carries an executive order, proclamation, or Commerce rule published between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-06 that prohibits or license-restricts US exports of diesel or distillate fuel oil, either generally or to European countries.
failure_condition: No Federal Register document published between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-06 prohibits or license-restricts US exports of diesel or distillate fuel oil.

statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-12-11, at least one person will be criminally charged by indictment or felony complaint over the alleged October 2024 sexual assault at a Cornell University fraternity house.
resolution: A New York Attorney General release or New York court record shows at least one person charged by indictment or felony complaint over the alleged October 2024 Cornell fraternity assault, filed between 2026-10-05 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: No person is charged by indictment or felony complaint over the alleged October 2024 Cornell fraternity assault between 2026-10-05 and 2026-12-11.

statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30, Congolese health authorities will report a cumulative Ebola death toll of at least 4,700 in the ongoing outbreak. Reference: 4,018 deaths reported on 2026-10-02.
resolution: Reuters, AP, or WHO publish a Congolese government cumulative Ebola death count of at least 4,700, dated between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 4,018 deaths reported on 2026-10-02.
failure_condition: No Congolese government cumulative Ebola death count dated between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-30 reaches 4,700.
